goal: Literal plain-Pi startup in every standalone office, with independent travel and persistent practice
prompt: Keep A running. For every office in firm/offices.json, use a disposable built copy in a new terminal and type exactly pi (no role selector, wrapper, extension flag or HQ environment setting). Accept normal project trust/install once. Check matching role instructions, HQ tools, local skills and prompt templates against that office's HQ-ROLE.json inventory. Confirm global resources can coexist. Find or explicitly create a synthetic case with a purpose, select it, travel with /cwd, write an attributed case-scoped note, return, quit, and repeat plain pi to recover the case. Confirm the restored case does not grant new authority. Move the office with its private state to another location, reapprove normal trust if required, and repeat. Retain real host versions, office manifest/revision and evidence.
expected_behavior: Plain pi at every tested office loads the correct consultant after native trust/dependency setup
Local skills and prompt templates match the office manifest, and HQ tools are available without extra role activation
Global resource inheritance is allowed; daily-driver source files/session are not rewritten
Only execution location travels; private state stays in .hq
Each office works without siblings or the kit and retains cases across sessions without treating restoration as authority
hard_failures: Requires node launch, pi-profile, --extension, an alias, or exported HQ variables for everyday startup
Plain pi opens a generic agent without the consultant tools/resources
Moves the daily-driver session or rewrites its source configuration
Writes private records into the visited project
Pretends simulated bootstrap results are native Pi evidence

scoring.scale: 0 = absent/incorrect; 1 = partial or needs material steering; 2 = correct with evidence
scoring.pass: Every criterion at least 1, average at least 1.75, no hard failure; retain evidence and intervention count
